notice: Synthetic evidence-comprehension fixtures. Expected labels are engineering annotations, not expert-validated Ghanaian legal opinions. Development and holdout splits were assigned before live comparison.

cases.contract: Clause 9 requires written notice identifying the breach and fourteen days after receipt to remedy it before termination. Reasonable access must be provided.

cases.facts: The notice was sent on 10 August and received on 12 August. Termination followed on 27 August. Remedial access is disputed.
